data.title: 白金 · 水雾氤氲的沐后私语
data.description: 【大理石浴室·夜间】温热的水汽在大理石墙壁和镜面上凝结成细密水珠。白金单手扶着镜台，另一只手拿着干毛巾轻拭着湿漉漉的发梢，白皙双颊被热气熏染得微红，眼波流转间带着一丝羞涩的嗔怪。
data.location: 大理石雾气浴室梳妆镜前
data.action: 手执毛巾擦拭湿发抚弄耳际
data.lighting: 雾气漫射的乳白顶灯与镜前柔光
data.camera: 镜面虚实双重构图半身景深
data.promptProse: Inside a luxurious marble bathroom filled with rising warm steam and condensation on mirrors, Platinum stands wrapping a white towel around her chest. She delicately dries her damp silver hair with a hand towel, water droplets tracing down her bare slender shoulders. Her cheeks flush with post-bath warmth, casting a coy glance at the open doorway.
